title.description: Short name of the task, shown to the user. At most 120 characters.

prompt.description: What the new session should do. It reaches that session as its first message.

initiation.description: offer: ask the user and wait. user_asked: start now. own_initiative: leave a card for later and do not wait.

context.description: fresh: only the prompt. fork: a copy of this conversation plus the prompt.

worktree.description: Run it in a new git worktree on a new branch, so its edits stay apart from this checkout.

model.description: Model id. Defaults to this session's model.

cwd.description: Folder to run in. Defaults to this session's folder.
